newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CNI sees Brazil's GDP growth at 4.5-5 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: CNI sees Brazil's GDP growth at 4.5-5 pct in 1997.

text.p: Brazil's National Industry Confederation (CNI) said it predicts the country's gross domestic product to grow between 4.5 percent and 5.0 percent next year.
In a forecast of Brazil's economy for 1997, CNI also said industrial output would grow between 4.0 percent and 5.0 percent due to an increase in consumption and private investments.
CNI also estimates the Brazilian economy will close 1996 with a growth rate of 3.2 percent, with industrial output growing 2.0 percent.
-- Fatima Cristina, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom, 55-21-5074151
